# Meridian 1.1.1
World clocks, full dates and local weather for your Mac.
- **DMG installer:** open the disk image and drag Meridian.app onto Applications. - **One running instance:** opening Meridian again reveals the existing app. A process lock prevents duplicates even from copied bundles or direct launches, and releases automatically after a crash. - **Website:** the GitHub Pages homepage now opens the bilingual product site, with DMG as the preferred download. - Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel; macOS 14 or later. English is the default, with live Simplified Chinese switching.
Download **Meridian-1.1.1-macOS.dmg** for first installation. The ZIP remains available for Sparkle automatic updates. SHA256SUMS covers both formats; the ZIP update archive is authenticated with Ed25519 signatures.
This release uses ad-hoc Apple code signing and is **not notarized**. macOS may block first launch under its security policy. Sparkle signing authenticates updates and does not replace Apple notarization.
**Noncommercial use only**, under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. See LICENSE and NOTICE. Third-party components keep their own licenses.
## 简体中文
新增 **DMG 拖拽安装包**，官网优先下载 DMG，ZIP 保留用于自动更新。
应用**只运行一个实例**。重复打开会唤起已有应用，复制应用或直接启动也受进程锁保护；异常退出后锁会自动释放。
已补全仓库简介、官网链接，并修正托管网站首页。仅限非商业使用；此版尚未经过 Apple 公证，首次打开可能受 macOS 安全策略限制。
